title: 五大行财报罕见撞车：分析师电话会撞时间，业绩预期增长20%
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Joining us now are Bloomberg Intelligence Senior Analyst for US Banks, Herman Chan, and the editor of Investopedia, Caleb Silver.
segments.zh: 今天请到的是彭博智库美国银行业高级分析师Herman Chan和Investopedia编辑Caleb Silver。

segments.en: All right. Mike Mayo, known weightlifter, hobbyist.
segments.zh: 好的，Mike Mayo，有名的举重爱好者。

segments.en: So it's the fact that he's skipping the gym. It's a big deal. It indicates how big this is.
segments.zh: 他连健身房都不去了，这很说明问题，可见这次有多重要。

segments.en: Do we always have to swim? Herman's the second swole that's on Wall Street.
segments.zh: 我们是不是总得游泳？Herman是华尔街第二个肌肉男。

segments.en: Oh, I'll take that. Yes, please. Thank you very much. I'm going to Barry's after this for a family show, right?
segments.zh: 哦，我接受这个称号。谢谢。之后我要去Barry's上一节家庭课。

segments.en: I'm going to dig a nap. All right. But you go work out.
segments.zh: 我要打个盹。好了，你去锻炼吧。

segments.en: Do we always get these all at once? And I was reading some analysis from Bloomberg, which I do now, a breed bank analysis, saying
segments.zh: 这些财报总是同时发布吗？我读了彭博的分析，说预期不错但不算惊艳。

segments.en: that it's expected to be good, but not amazing. Why is that?
segments.zh: 预期不错但不算惊艳，为什么？

segments.en: Right. So Banks typically try to stagger their earnings. But for some reason, this earnings calendar, there's five in one day and Bank of America and JP Morgan
segments.zh: 银行通常错开发布财报，但这次一天有五家，美国银行和摩根大通的电话会议时间还冲突了。

segments.en: have competing earnings call times at the same time on Tuesday.
So yeah, it's great for us, Bank Analyst, trying to listen to earnings calls at the same time.
segments.zh: 对我们银行分析师来说，同时听多个财报电话会确实很棒。

segments.en: But we're expecting really strong results overall for the banking sector this quarter.
segments.zh: 但我们预计本季度银行业整体业绩会非常强劲。

segments.en: But Banks have really shrugged off some of these geo-economic issues and the K-shaped economy that we continue to hear about.
segments.zh: 不过银行已摆脱地缘经济问题和K型经济的影响。

segments.en: There's really strong earnings power, both on the trading side, the investment banking side, and on the lending side, your typical bread and butter commercial lending is really strong.
segments.zh: 交易、投行和传统商业贷款业务盈利强劲。

segments.en: So about 20% year-over-year growth. So yeah, we're looking for really good results overall.
segments.zh: 同比增长约20%，我们期待整体业绩亮眼。

segments.en: OK, let me ask you just about the role that SpaceX is going to play in all of this.
segments.zh: 好的，我想问一下SpaceX在其中扮演什么角色？
